documentation.overview:
Use the Flint Pay SDK to integrate with the Flint API from your server. See the [Flint Pay SDK documentation](https://developers.withflintpay.com/docs/guides/sdks) for setup and integration guides. The default base URL is production (`https://api.withflintpay.com`). For sandbox testing, pass `baseUrl` as `https://api.staging.withflintpay.com`, or set `API_BASE_URL` to that URL when running example scripts. See the [SDK ↔ API version mapping](https://github.com/flint-pay/flint-sdks#sdk--api-versions) for version history.

Generated with [Flint's SDK generator](https://github.com/flint-pay/sdk-generator). Submit fixes and pull requests to the generator; this distribution repository does not accept pull requests.

guides.pagination-and-retries:
# Pagination and retries

Cursor helpers follow `page_token` and `next_page_token` lazily and retain your filters. `listItems` yields resources; `listPages` yields page bodies with `data` and `next_page_token`. Use `WithResponse` companions for HTTP metadata. Pagination stops after 1,000 pages by default; set `maxPages` or `maxItems` explicitly for larger traversals. `deadlineMs` bounds each page request. Cancellation bounds the whole iteration.

All operations make one attempt by default. This release preserves caller-supplied idempotency keys and does not generate keys automatically. Persist a key for each business action and reuse it only when retrying that action. Operations with a required key reject calls without one before dispatch. See [runtime options](../RUNTIME.md) for request options and the API reference for each operation's declared idempotency contract.

`packages.listItems()` iterates packages; `packages.listPackageItems()` lists contents of a package. `riskLists.listItems()` iterates lists; `riskLists.listRiskListItems()` lists entries inside one risk list.

idempotency.retention: At least 24 hours for ordinary replay records; durable command identities follow their documented resource lifetime. Never reuse for a new business intent.
idempotency.scope: Authenticated context, environment, HTTP endpoint and caller key; the canonical request fingerprint includes target resource IDs and request parameters.
